headline: Sakayori Lab slips out of ARC-2 gold places

sections.text: Sakayori Lab fell from 14th to 17th at 68.06, with its score unchanged in the past day. That leaves the team just outside the 16 gold places.
The gold line rose 2.22 to 68.75, putting Sakayori Lab 0.69 short. The standings remain provisional, with medals decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
